text:
Troy Terry has eight games in this season, all since November 11, and no goals yet. He has two assists, 11 shots and 1.2 expected goals, our measure of chance quality, so he is about one goal behind where his looks say he should be. The Ducks have also scored about three fewer goals than expected with him on the ice. Seattle's Joey Daccord made the point on November 23, robbing him with the paddle in a game where Terry played 20.6 minutes.

The underlying signs are better than the box score. Anaheim has taken 55.7% of the five-on-five shot attempts with him out there, and his history says he drives play: Evolving-Hockey had his team creating 0.23 more expected goals per 60 with him on the ice last season, 94th percentile among forwards. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking has him carrying the puck in on 60% of his entries, a setup man at 8.2 primary shot assists per 60. Our numbers project 40 points. Eight games is far too few to worry about.
headline: Troy Terry is creating, the puck isn't going in
